<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en"><head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=1440">
<title>Licensing — PointSav, Inc.</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Barlow+Condensed:wght@400;500;600;700&family=League+Gothic&family=Mulish:ital,wght@0,300..700;1,400&family=Nunito+Sans:ital,wght@0,300..700;1,400&family=Oswald:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Roboto+Slab:wght@300;400;500;700&family=Zilla+Slab:ital,wght@0,300;0,400;0,500;0,700;1,300;1,400&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  /* ── Woodfine tokens ───────────────────────────────────────────── */
  :root {
    --paper:    #FFFFFF;
    --paper-2:  #F7F9FA;
    --paper-3:  #E6E7E8;

    --ink:         #111827;
    --ink-2:       #374151;
    --ink-3:       #6B7280;
    --ink-4:       #9CA3AF;
    --rule:        #E6E7E8;
    --rule-strong: #9CA3AF;

    --wf-blue:    #164679;
    --wf-blue-tint: #E8EFF7;

    --accent:      var(--wf-blue);
    --accent-tint: var(--wf-blue-tint);

    /* Brand-aligned 3-font system (free Google substitutes for Trade Gothic / Caecilia / Avenir) */
    --display: "Oswald", "Trade Gothic LT Std", "Barlow Condensed", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;
    --serif:   "Roboto Slab", "Caecilia LT Std", "Zilla Slab", Georgia, serif;
    --sans:    "Nunito Sans", "Avenir LT Std", "Avenir Next", "Mulish", -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
  }

  *,
  *::before,
  *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }

  html, body {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    background: var(--paper-2);
    color: var(--ink);
    font-family: var(--sans);
    font-size: 14px;
    line-height: 1.55;
    -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  }

  a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }

  /* ── Outer page (mimics paper-on-canvas) ───────────────────────── */
  .page {
    width: 1440px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    background: var(--paper-2);
    padding: 32px 0 0;
  }

  /* ── Header ────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  .topnav {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr auto 1fr;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 0 56px;
    margin-bottom: 28px;
  }
  .topnav .left,
  .topnav .right {
    display: flex;
    gap: 36px;
    font-family: var(--sans);
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.14em;
    color: var(--ink-3);
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  .topnav .left { justify-content: flex-start; }
  .topnav .right {
    justify-content: flex-end;
    color: var(--accent);
  }
  .topnav .left a:hover,
  .topnav .right a:hover { opacity: 0.7; }

  .wordmark {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    line-height: 1;
  }
  .wordmark img, .wordmark .logo-svg {
    display: block;
    height: 80px;
    width: 320px;
    /* SVG has institutional-fill paths — set color via filter-free approach: */
    /* the SVG uses currentColor where possible; otherwise it carries its own fill */
  }

  /* ── Document area (white card on canvas) ─────────────────────── */
  .doc {
    margin: 0 56px;
    background: var(--paper);
    border: 0;
  }

  /* Sub-nav (HOME tab) */
  .subnav {
    background: var(--paper);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
    padding: 14px 36px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: flex-end;
    gap: 12px;
  }
  .subnav .tabs-right {
    display: flex;
    gap: 8px;
  }
  .subnav .tab {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    text-align: center;
    background: var(--accent);
    color: #fff;
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.16em;
    line-height: 1.25;
    padding: 8px 14px;
    min-width: 130px;
    min-height: 40px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    cursor: default;
    box-sizing: border-box;
  }

  /* ── Hero band (blue) ─────────────────────────────────────────── */
  .hero {
    background: var(--accent);
    color: #fff;
    padding: 22px 64px 26px;
  }
  .hero .kicker {
    text-align: center;
    font-family: var(--sans);
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.22em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: #fff;
    padding-top: 12px;
    padding-bottom: 12px;
    border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
    margin: 0 auto 14px;
    max-width: none;
  }
  .hero p {
    font-family: var(--serif);
    font-size: 19px;
    line-height: 1.55;
    color: #fff;
    text-align: center;
    max-width: none;
    margin: 0 auto;
    text-wrap: pretty;
  }

  /* ── Project classes band (grey) ───────────────────────────────── */
  .classes {
    background: var(--paper-3);
    padding: 0 36px;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
    gap: 0;
    align-items: center;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  .class {
    position: relative;
  }
  .class .icon {
    height: 180px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    margin-bottom: 0;
    overflow: visible;
  }
  /* SVGs include their own text labels and have ~50% transparent padding
     inside the viewBox. Show them at full square size; let neighbours
     overlap via negative inline margin to bring icons visually closer. */
  .class .icon svg, .class .icon .class-icon {
    display: block;
    width: 240px;
    height: 240px;
    margin: 0 -110px;
  }
  .class .label {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 2;
  }
  .class {
    text-align: center;
    color: var(--ink);
  }

  .class .label {
    font-family: var(--sans);
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.18em;
    line-height: 1.4;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }

  /* ── Value-prop grid ──────────────────────────────────────────── */
  .props {
    padding: 36px 120px 56px;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
    gap: 0 24px;
  }
  .prop {
    padding-top: 14px;
    padding-right: 10px;
  }
  .prop + .prop { /* divider before each except first in row handled separately */ }
  .prop { position: relative; }
  a.prop {
    display: block;
    color: inherit;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: background 160ms ease;
  }
  a.prop:hover { background: var(--paper-3); }
  a.prop:hover h3 { color: var(--accent); }
  a.prop .ext {
    font-family: var(--sans);
    font-weight: 600;
    margin-left: 6px;
    font-size: 0.85em;
    color: var(--accent);
    letter-spacing: 0;
    display: inline-block;
    transform: translateY(-1px);
  }
  .prop + .prop::before {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    left: -12px; top: 14px; bottom: 14px;
    width: 1px;
    background: var(--rule);
  }
  .props .row-2:first-of-type::before { display: none; }
  .prop .propnum {
    display: block;
    font-family: var(--display);
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.18em;
    color: var(--ink-4);
    margin-bottom: 6px;
  }
  .prop h3 sup, .compliance sup, .hero p sup {
    font-size: 0.65em; vertical-align: super; line-height: 0;
    color: var(--ink-3);
    font-weight: 500;
    padding-left: 1px;
  }
  .hero p sup { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7); }
  .compliance {
    margin: 0 56px 0;
    background: var(--paper-2);
    border-top: 1px solid var(--rule);
    padding: 28px 120px 32px;
  }
  .compliance h4 {
    margin: 0 0 14px;
    font-family: var(--display);
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.22em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--ink-3);
  }
  .compliance p {
    margin: 0 0 10px;
    font-family: var(--sans);
    font-size: 11px;
    line-height: 1.55;
    color: var(--ink-3);
  }
  .compliance p:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
  .compliance strong { color: var(--ink-2); font-weight: 700; }
  .compliance em { font-style: italic; }
  .prop h3 {
    margin: 0 0 6px 0;
    font-family: var(--sans);
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.16em;
    color: var(--accent);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    border-top: 2px solid var(--accent);
    padding-top: 14px;
  }
  .prop p {
    margin: 8px 0 0 0;
    font-family: var(--sans);
    font-size: 13px;
    line-height: 1.55;
    color: var(--ink);
  }

  /* second row spacing */
  .props .row-2 { margin-top: 28px; }

  /* === Footer (matches Disclaimer page) === */
  footer {
    margin: 0 56px;
    background: var(--paper-2);
    border-top: 1px solid var(--rule);
    padding: 0 0 20px;
  }
  .footer-nav {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    margin-bottom: 14px;
    background: #B4C5D5;
    padding: 18px 140px;
  }
  .footer-bottom-wrap { padding: 0 140px; }
  .footer-nav .offices {
    font-family: var(--display);
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.14em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: #164679;
  }
  .footer-nav .offices span { margin: 0 6px; color: #164679; opacity: 0.45; }
  .footer-nav .footer-links a { color: #164679; }
  .footer-nav .footer-links a:hover { color: #0f3056; }
  .footer-links {
    display: flex;
    gap: 20px;
    font-family: var(--display);
    font-size: 11px;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  .footer-links a { color: var(--ink-3); text-decoration: none; }
  .footer-links a:hover { color: var(--accent); }
  .footer-bottom {
    border-top: 1px solid var(--rule);
    padding-top: 14px;
    font-family: var(--sans);
    font-size: 11px;
    color: var(--ink-3);
    line-height: 1.7;
  }
  .footer-bottom strong { color: var(--ink-2); }
  .footer-version {
    margin-top: 10px;
    font-family: var(--sans);
    font-size: 10px;
    color: var(--ink-4);
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  }

  /* ── Tweaks panel hooks ───────────────────────────────────────── */
  .tweak-hide-image .class .icon svg { opacity: 0.15; }

  /* Font pairing presets — body class drives --serif / --sans */
  /* Brand presets (3-font system: display / body-slab / UI-sans) */
  body.fp-brand            { --display: "Oswald", sans-serif; --serif: "Roboto Slab", Georgia, serif; --sans: "Nunito Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; }
  body.fp-brand-zilla      { --display: "Oswald", sans-serif; --serif: "Zilla Slab", Georgia, serif; --sans: "Mulish", system-ui, sans-serif; }
  body.fp-barlow-roboto    { --display: "Barlow Condensed", sans-serif; --serif: "Roboto Slab", Georgia, serif; --sans: "Nunito Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; }
  body.fp-league-zilla     { --display: "League Gothic", sans-serif; --serif: "Zilla Slab", Georgia, serif; --sans: "Nunito Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; }
  body.fp-system           { --display: -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; --serif: ui-serif, Georgia, serif; --sans: -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; }

  /* Apply display font to wordmark area, hero kicker, project class labels, value-prop kickers */
  .hero .kicker      { font-family: var(--display); font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.16em; }
  .class .label      { font-family: var(--display); font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.18em; }
  .prop h3           { font-family: var(--display); font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.14em; }
  .topnav .left, .topnav .right { font-family: var(--display); font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.16em; }
  .subnav .tab       { font-family: var(--display); font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.16em; }
  /* Body / paragraph slab */
  .hero p, .prop p   { font-family: var(--serif); }

  /* hero kicker can be serif italic on some pairings */
  body.kicker-serif .hero .kicker { font-family: var(--serif); font-style: italic; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-transform: none; font-size: 16px; }
  body.kicker-serif .prop h3      { font-family: var(--serif); font-style: italic; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.01em; text-transform: none; font-size: 15px; }

  /* ── Page hero band (subpage) ─────────────────────────────────── */
  .page-hero {
    margin: 0 56px;
    background: var(--paper-3);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
    padding: 22px 140px;
    text-align: center;
  }
  .page-hero h1 {
    margin: 0;
    font-family: var(--display);
    font-size: 22px;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.18em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--ink);
  }
  .topnav .left,
  .topnav .right {
    align-items: center;
  }
  .topnav .left a,
  .topnav .right a {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    height: 32px;
    padding: 0 4px;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    line-height: 1;
  }
  .topnav .left a.active-page {
    background: #B4C5D5;
    color: var(--accent);
    padding: 0 14px;
    letter-spacing: 0.16em;
  }
  .subpage-subnav {
    margin: 0 56px;
    background: var(--paper);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
    padding: 14px 140px;
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px;
    font-family: var(--display);
    font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--ink-3);
  }
  .subpage-subnav a:hover { color: var(--accent); }
  .subpage-subnav .sep { color: var(--ink-4); }

  /* Subpage main */
  .subpage-main {
    margin: 0 56px;
    background: var(--paper);
    min-height: 1200px;
    padding: 48px 140px 80px;
  }

  /* Contact layout */
  .contact-grid { display: flex; gap: 80px; }
  .contact-grid .col-left { flex: 0 0 320px; }
  .contact-grid .intro-text {
    font-family: var(--sans);
    font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.7; color: var(--accent);
    margin-bottom: 36px;
  }
  .email-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 18px; }
  .email-icon {
    width: 58px; height: 58px; border-radius: 50%;
    border: 2px solid var(--ink);
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }
  .email-icon svg { width: 28px; height: 28px; stroke: var(--ink); fill: none; stroke-width: 1.5; }
  .email-address {
    font-family: var(--display);
    font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    color: var(--ink);
  }
  .contact-grid .col-right { flex: 1; }
  .office-block {
    margin-bottom: 36px; padding-bottom: 36px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
  }
  .office-block:last-child { border-bottom: 0; margin-bottom: 0; padding-bottom: 0; }
  .office-city {
    font-family: var(--display);
    font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.18em;
    text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--accent); margin-bottom: 10px;
  }
  .office-address { font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.75; color: var(--ink); }
  .office-address strong { font-family: var(--sans); font-weight: 700; color: var(--ink); }

  /* Disclaimer layout */
  .disclaimer-body { max-width: 760px; margin: 0 auto; }
  .disclaimer-body p {
    font-family: var(--serif);
    font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.75; color: var(--ink-2);
    margin-bottom: 18px;
  }
  .disclaimer-body ol { list-style: none; counter-reset: dc; margin: 16px 0 0 0; padding: 0; }
  .disclaimer-body ol li {
    counter-increment: dc;
    font-family: var(--serif);
    font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.75; color: var(--ink-2);
    margin-bottom: 22px; padding-left: 28px; position: relative;
  }
  .disclaimer-body ol li::before {
    content: counter(dc) ".";
    position: absolute; left: 0; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink);
  }
  .disclaimer-body ol li strong { font-weight: 700; color: var(--ink); }
  </style>
<style>
  /* ── Software page: a small extension on the existing system ─────── */
  .installers-intro {
    max-width: 760px;
    margin: 0 auto 28px;
  }
  .installers-intro p {
    font-family: var(--serif);
    font-size: 15px;
    line-height: 1.75;
    color: var(--ink-2);
    text-wrap: pretty;
  }
  .installers-intro p + p { margin-top: 12px; }
  .installers-intro p strong { font-family: var(--sans); color: var(--ink); font-weight: 700; }

  .installers {
    max-width: 920px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    border-top: 2px solid var(--ink);
  }
  .installer {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 100px 110px 90px 110px;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 16px;
    padding: 20px 4px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
  }
  .installer:last-child { border-bottom: 2px solid var(--ink); }
  .installer .name {
    font-family: var(--display);
    font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--ink);
  }
  .installer .name small {
    display: block;
    margin-top: 4px;
    font-family: var(--serif);
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 400;
    letter-spacing: 0;
    text-transform: none;
    color: var(--ink-3);
    line-height: 1.5;
  }
  .installer .name small .tag {
    display: inline-block;
    margin-left: 4px;
    padding: 1px 6px;
    font-family: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace;
    font-size: 10px;
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    color: var(--accent);
    background: var(--accent-tint);
    border-radius: 2px;
    white-space: nowrap;
    vertical-align: 2px;
  }
  .installer .col {
    font-family: var(--sans);
    font-size: 12px;
    color: var(--ink-2);
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  }
  .installer .col .label {
    display: block;
    font-family: var(--display);
    font-size: 9px;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.18em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--ink-4);
    margin-bottom: 4px;
  }
  .installer .get {
    justify-self: end;
    font-family: var(--display);
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.16em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--accent);             /* Woodfine blue text */
    background: #B4C5D5;              /* steel */
    padding: 10px 18px;
    text-decoration: none;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
  }
  .installer .get:hover { background: #A0B5C8; }

  /* Header row labels on first row */
  .installers .head {
    padding: 12px 4px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
  }
  .installers .head .col,
  .installers .head .name {
    font-family: var(--display);
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.18em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--ink-3);
  }

  /* Footnote */
  .installers-note {
    max-width: 920px;
    margin: 28px auto 0;
    padding: 22px 24px;
    background: var(--accent-tint);
    border-left: 3px solid var(--accent);
    font-family: var(--serif);
    font-size: 13px;
    line-height: 1.75;
    color: var(--ink-2);
  }
  .installers-note strong {
    font-family: var(--sans);
    color: var(--ink);
    font-weight: 700;
  }
  .installers-note a { color: var(--accent); text-decoration: underline; }
</style>

<style>
  /* ── Licensing page additions ──────────────────────────────────── */

  .lic-intro { max-width: 920px; margin: 0 auto 36px; }
  .lic-intro p {
    font-family: var(--serif);
    font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.75; color: var(--ink-2);
    text-wrap: pretty;
  }
  .lic-intro p + p { margin-top: 12px; }
  .lic-intro strong { font-family: var(--sans); color: var(--ink); font-weight: 700; }

  /* Two-column free/paid header */
  .lic-section {
    max-width: 920px;
    margin: 0 auto 48px;
  }
  .lic-section-head {
    display: flex;
    align-items: baseline;
    gap: 14px;
    padding-bottom: 12px;
    margin-bottom: 18px;
    border-bottom: 2px solid var(--ink);
  }
  .lic-section-head .marker {
    font-family: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace;
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.16em;
    color: var(--accent);
    background: var(--accent-tint);
    padding: 4px 10px;
    border-radius: 2px;
  }
  .lic-section-head .marker.free { color: var(--ink); background: var(--paper-3); }
  .lic-section-head h2 {
    font-family: var(--display);
    font-size: 22px;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.14em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--ink);
    margin: 0;
  }

  .lic-section .blurb {
    font-family: var(--serif);
    font-size: 14px;
    line-height: 1.75;
    color: var(--ink-2);
    margin-bottom: 8px;
  }
  .lic-section .blurb .inline-action {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
    margin-left: 4px;
    font-family: var(--display);
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.16em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--accent);
    background: #B4C5D5;
    padding: 8px 16px;
    text-decoration: none;
    vertical-align: 2px;
  }
  .lic-section .blurb .inline-action:hover { background: #A0B5C8; }
  .lic-section .blurb code {
    font-family: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace;
    font-size: 12.5px;
    color: var(--accent);
    background: var(--accent-tint);
    padding: 1px 6px;
    border-radius: 2px;
  }

  /* Free claim block */
  .free-claim {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr auto;
    gap: 24px;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 22px 24px;
    background: var(--paper-2);
    border-top: 1px solid var(--rule);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
  }
  .free-claim .what {
    font-family: var(--sans);
    font-size: 13px;
    color: var(--ink-2);
    line-height: 1.6;
  }
  .free-claim .what strong {
    display: block;
    font-family: var(--display);
    font-size: 14px;
    letter-spacing: 0.14em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--ink);
    margin-bottom: 4px;
  }
  .btn-primary {
    font-family: var(--display);
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.16em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--accent);
    background: #B4C5D5;
    border: none;
    padding: 12px 22px;
    cursor: pointer;
    text-decoration: none;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
  }
  .btn-primary:hover { background: #A0B5C8; }
  .btn-secondary {
    font-family: var(--display);
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.16em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--accent);
    background: #B4C5D5;
    border: none;
    padding: 12px 22px;
    cursor: pointer;
    text-decoration: none;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
  }
  .btn-secondary:hover { background: #A0B5C8; }

  /* Paid license rows (mirrors .installer pattern) */
  .licenses {
    border-top: 2px solid var(--ink);
  }
  .license {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr auto;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 16px;
    padding: 20px 4px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
  }
  .license:last-child { border-bottom: 2px solid var(--ink); }
  .license .name {
    font-family: var(--display);
    font-size: 15px;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--ink);
  }
  .license .name small {
    display: block;
    margin-top: 4px;
    font-family: var(--serif);
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 400;
    letter-spacing: 0;
    text-transform: none;
    color: var(--ink-3);
    line-height: 1.5;
  }
  .license .name small .tag {
    display: inline-block;
    margin-left: 4px;
    padding: 1px 6px;
    font-family: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace;
    font-size: 10px;
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    color: var(--accent);
    background: var(--accent-tint);
    border-radius: 2px;
    white-space: nowrap;
    vertical-align: 2px;
  }
  .license .col {
    font-family: var(--sans);
    font-size: 12px;
    color: var(--ink-2);
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  }
  .license .col .label {
    display: block;
    font-family: var(--display);
    font-size: 9px;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.18em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--ink-4);
    margin-bottom: 4px;
  }
  .license .col.price-col {
    font-family: var(--display);
    font-size: 18px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--ink);
    letter-spacing: 0;
  }
  .license .col.price-col .label { color: var(--ink-4); font-size: 9px; }
  .license .mint {
    justify-self: end;
    font-family: var(--display);
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.16em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--accent);
    background: #B4C5D5;
    padding: 10px 18px;
    text-decoration: none;
  }
  .license .mint:hover { background: #A0B5C8; }
  .licenses .head {
    padding: 12px 4px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
  }
  .licenses .head .col,
  .licenses .head .name {
    font-family: var(--display);
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.18em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--ink-3);
  }

  /* ── Wallet panel (simplified to 2 rows) ───────────────────────── */
  .wallet {
    max-width: 920px;
    margin: 0 auto 32px;
    border: 1px solid var(--ink);
    background: var(--paper);
  }
  .wallet-row {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 110px 1fr auto;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 20px;
    padding: 18px 24px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
  }
  .wallet-row:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
  .wallet-row .label {
    font-family: var(--display);
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.2em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--ink-4);
  }
  .wallet-row .body {
    font-family: var(--sans);
    font-size: 13px;
    color: var(--ink);
    line-height: 1.5;
  }
  .chains {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 6px;
  }
  .chains .chain {
    font-family: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace;
    font-size: 11px;
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    color: var(--ink-2);
    background: var(--paper-2);
    border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong);
    padding: 4px 10px;
    border-radius: 2px;
    cursor: pointer;
  }
  .chains .chain.on {
    color: var(--accent);
    background: var(--accent-tint);
    border-color: var(--accent);
  }
  .chains .chain.dim {
    color: var(--ink-4);
    border-color: var(--rule);
  }

  /* Tax row */
  .wallet .tax-row { background: var(--paper-2); }
  .wallet .tax-row .body {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr auto;
    gap: 16px;
    align-items: baseline;
  }
  .wallet .tax-row .juris {
    font-family: var(--sans);
    color: var(--ink-2);
  }
  .wallet .tax-row .juris .auto {
    color: var(--accent);
    text-decoration: underline;
    text-underline-offset: 2px;
    cursor: pointer;
  }
  .wallet .tax-row .change {
    font-family: var(--display);
    font-size: 10px;
    letter-spacing: 0.18em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--ink-3);
    text-decoration: underline;
    cursor: pointer;
    margin-left: 8px;
  }
  .wallet .tax-row .totals {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: auto auto;
    column-gap: 18px;
    row-gap: 4px;
    align-items: baseline;
    justify-content: end;
    font-family: var(--sans);
    font-size: 13px;
    color: var(--ink-2);
  }
  .wallet .tax-row .totals .k { color: var(--ink-3); }
  .wallet .tax-row .totals .v { color: var(--ink); text-align: right; }
  .wallet .tax-row .totals .total-k,
  .wallet .tax-row .totals .total-v {
    border-top: 1px solid var(--rule);
    padding-top: 6px;
    margin-top: 2px;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--ink);
  }
  .wallet .tax-row .totals .total-v {
    font-family: var(--display);
    font-size: 16px;
    letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  }

  /* Compliance-style footnote (matches Software page tint) */
  .lic-note {
    max-width: 920px;
    margin: 28px auto 0;
    padding: 22px 24px;
    background: var(--accent-tint);
    border-left: 3px solid var(--accent);
    font-family: var(--serif);
    font-size: 13px;
    line-height: 1.75;
    color: var(--ink-2);
  }
  .lic-note strong {
    font-family: var(--sans);
    color: var(--ink);
    font-weight: 700;
  }
  .lic-note p + p { margin-top: 10px; }
  .lic-note code {
    font-family: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace;
    font-size: 12.5px;
    color: var(--accent);
    background: rgba(22,70,121,0.08);
    padding: 1px 6px;
    border-radius: 2px;
  }
</style>
